root_cause: When `signature_zone` (a Zone) was replaced by the custom `WasmModuleSignatureStorage` class in commit b9068d13bb1, the new class's `TotalReservedSize()` accessor was invoked from `WasmModule::EstimateStoredSize()`/`EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` exactly as the old Zone accessor had been — i.e., without any synchronization — even though the class's own doc comment states that `signature_storage` is mutated during instantiation on a `const WasmModule`. The call chain `NativeModule::EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` → `module_->EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` executes before `NativeModule::allocation_mutex_` is acquired in that function, so a concurrent instantiation thread appending to `signature_storage` races with the reading thread.
findings: WasmModule::EstimateStoredSize() reads `signature_storage.TotalReservedSize()` (and the aggregate `WasmModule::EstimateCurrentMemoryConsumption()` which calls EstimateStoredSize()) without acquiring any lock.
